# Newcol

> A browser remake of Sid Meier's Colonization (1994): a deterministic, seeded colony sim
> in TypeScript + Vite + Three.js. No backend, no login, no tracking.

The game at the root URL: settle a coastal colony, trade with the native nations already
here, ship goods through per-empire European markets that drift with your own dumping,
manufacture raw goods into premium ones, and outlast a crown whose invading expeditions
are funded by the taxes you paid.

## Resources

- [Game](/): play a colony from 1607; add ?seed=NNNN for a specific world.
